none: PAS NLM-1C73A2: Roman Coin: Copy Nummus of Constantius II from Winterton
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Probably Copy Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), issue of 335-341, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust diademed and cuirassed right, large eye. Obverse description: [---]TIVS[--]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORI]A EXERC[ITVS]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this small coin. Diameter: 14.4mm, Weight: 0.92gms,…
